title: Heat--Airy Transport of Differential Operators and Moving Boundaries
summary: We study the transport of polynomial differential operators under the two-parameter commuting evolution \[ P_{t,s} = \exp\left( \frac{t}{2}D^2-\frac{s}{3}D^3 \right), \qquad D=\frac{d}{dx}. \] Conjugation of the position operator gives \[ P_{t,s}xP_{t,s}^{-1} = x+tD-sD^2, \] which leads to a recursive normal-ordering expansion and to a family of Heat--Airy polynomials arising as its derivative-free coefficients.
